e.markdown:
**Diagnosis**
The collision probability on TM-CONJ-02 is 0.00021, which exceeds the action threshold of 1e-4 for CDM-0412 (Object 58321) [TM-CONJ-02]. The avoidance maneuver requires a burn from the 1 N monopropellant thruster (P-PROP-04), but the thruster’s catalyst bed heater is out of tolerance (NCR-002) and was flown “Use-as-is under deviation” [NCR-002]. As a result the bed reaches the required 315 °C only after ~43.4 min of preheat instead of the 30 min specified in REQ-PROP-028 [REQ-PROP-028], delaying the burn timeline.

**Why the build record mattered**
The spec-sheet model assumes a 30 min preheat (REQ-PROP-028) and would allow a decision deadline of T+45 min (spec heater: 30 min preheat + 15 min margin). The as-flown condition from NCR-002 adds ~13.4 min of preheat (43.4 min - 30 min) [NCR-002], moving the latest feasible start time earlier to T+32 min (as shown in the the autonomy policy counterfactual). Without this build record the prognosis would incorrectly suggest ample operator time; the record shows the timeline is tighter and that the operator must act sooner to meet the avoidance window.

**For the operator**
*At the next pass (On-call operator, T+20 min)*
- Review the latest TM-CONJ-02 collision probability and confirm it remains >1e-4.
- Verify the catalyst bed temperature trend and approve start of preheat by T+32 min to meet the burn deadline.
- Authorise the collision-avoidance burn parameters (Δv≈0.075 m/s, burn duration ≈45.4 s, lead time ≈74.6 min) as proposed in the autonomy policy.
- Monitor heater temperature to ensure it reaches ≥315 °C before ignition.

*Afterwards*
- After the burn completes (≈T+65 min, based on cmdT=2 min + burnT≈45.4 s), check TM-CONJ-02 for reduced collision probability.
- At closest approach (T+120 min) confirm the predicted miss distance stays ≥180 m and that no anomaly flags appear in thruster telemetry.
- Post-eclipse (after T+170 min) perform a delta-v budget check using REQ-SYS-002 to verify remaining propellant matches the expected 130.93 m/s margin.
